design.null_world: Species baseline binary-trait frequency changes with geographic species centre; trait state has no within-species spatial dependence.
design.signal_world: Same between-species turnover plus a within-species local spatial effect on trait probability.

interpretation.supported: In this targeted confounding benchmark, naive pooling systematically mistakes between-species geographic turnover for within-species spatial organization, whereas the species-conditioned matched-null test is calibrated in the null worlds and detects the imposed within-species signal.
not_supported: general superiority over all spatial methods
power calibration across arbitrary effect sizes, missingness, observation imbalance or trait types
empirical performance outside the simulated failure mode
